reason: I’ll form the metal stock into a case structure for the band core.
expectation: The folding jig will produce a case or frame that can be insulated and refrigerated.

alternatives.reason: Preparing the cold packs also seems useful, but I want to build the case first.

effect: The jig formed a field case shell, giving me a structure to insulate.
reaction: The result is straightforward and reassuring.
reason: Insulating the shell seems like the next practical step toward keeping the core cold.
expectation: The felt will line or wrap the shell to reduce heat entering the case.

alternatives.reason: The cold packs will likely need preparation too, but I want to finish the insulated case first.

effect: The felt made an insulated field case, ready for a cooling component.
reaction: The assembly is straightforward so far.
reason: The refrigeration insert looks like the natural next part of the case.
expectation: It will add active cooling to the insulated case, though the cold packs may still be needed.

alternatives.reason: The cold packs also need preparation, but I want to fit the insert first.

effect: The case now has refrigeration and a cradle for the core's liner; the radiator releases heat outside the case.
reaction: The explanation of where the removed heat goes is satisfying.
reason: Preparing the cold packs is the only offered combination and seems useful for keeping the sample cold.
expectation: The freezer will chill the packs for use with the refrigerated case, though I don't yet know how they will fit.

effect: The freezer prepared cold packs that can absorb heat during a transfer, but their capacity is limited and must be restored by refrigeration.
reaction: The distinction between temporary cold storage and active refrigeration is useful.
reason: Fitting the conditioned packs into the case is the only offered combination and should help protect the core during transfer.
expectation: The packs will be added to the refrigerated case to provide temporary cooling during transfer.

effect: The case is complete: refrigeration maintains its temperature, and the cartridges provide a short buffer during power changes.
reaction: The specific role of the cartridges makes the assembly feel purposeful.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the refrigeration insert was most worthwhile because it explained how the case removes heat and releases it through the radiator.

leastWorthwhile.text: Forming and insulating the shell felt straightforward, with little to discover in the results.

surprise.text: The cold packs provide only a limited transfer margin and need refrigeration to restore their capacity.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each part had a clear role in building or cooling the case.

continue.text: Yes. I am curious whether a whole piece of the band will preserve more information than the damaged flake, and the cold-case construction gave that next step a practical purpose.
